note: Private staging verification. Only the regression suites were run on this build: the full non-browser suite (including the release-metadata, live-check AWS SigV4 and profiles deep-path gates) and the browser/UI suite, both on loopback fixtures with synthetic, nonfunctional keys. No non-loopback connection was made. 3.0.0 changes no ready option, limit, sizing, pacing, analysis-memory ceiling or detector rule; its changes are the opt-in AWS live-key-check provider and a larger deployment-path list a scan probes. The pinned-engine corpus recall, the cancellation-stress run, the CLI and persistence smokes and the mass-scan figures are therefore carried over from 2.9.1 (see ../TEST_RESULTS.md) and are not re-measured here. The ready-option matrix was measured again on the Linux server (linuxServer), and the 3.0.0 packages were built and checked on this build: packaged-smoke.json, root-parity.json and source-integrity.json for Windows x64 and Source, linux-server.json for the Linux x64 package and the container image. The complete verification set will be produced on the release build before any public release.
linuxServer: After this Windows run, the Linux jobs of linux.yml and the ready-option performance and recall matrix were run on the same build on a Linux server (2026-10-17): linux-server.json, linux-server-matrix.md/.json and linux-server-bundle-rerun.json. The matrix there replaces the carried-over 2.9.1 matrix for 3.0.0; the other carried-over items above stay carried over.
